Who we are

An advisory partner that turns intent into delivery

Stratovate Solutions (Pty) Ltd is a South African advisory firm specialising in strategy, operations and logistics, corporate social responsibility, enterprise and supplier development, and research support. We are 100% black owned and 100% black woman owned, a B-BBEE Level 1 contributor, in good standing with SARS and verified on the Central Supplier Database.

We work where funding meets delivery. Many organisations commit to transformation and enterprise development, but results depend on whether programmes are properly designed, implemented and measured. That is our craft, and we report on it honestly.

Our Vision

To be a trusted South African partner that turns responsible business spending into real economic participation for people and enterprises that have been left on the margins.

Our Mission

To design and deliver practical strategy, corporate social responsibility and enterprise development programmes that are properly implemented, measured and reported, so that funders see results and beneficiaries build lasting capability.

  • Integrity. We report honestly and never fabricate results.
  • Practicality. Solutions built for South African realities.
  • Transformation. Widening genuine participation in the economy.
  • Accountability. We measure what we do and stand behind it.
Operations & Logistics

Operations and logistics that keep supply reliable

Our operations practice is led by Wesley Rabie, who has more than twenty years in manufacturing, logistics and technical operations, including senior roles over depots, inventory, supply chain and warehousing. We build the systems that let businesses and programmes deliver consistently.

Warehousing & stock control

Warehouse layout, receiving and dispatch, first-in-first-out stock rotation, cycle counts and stock-take discipline, so stock records match what is on the shelf.

Procurement & supplier management

Quotations, purchase orders, supplier selection and follow-up, service-level monitoring and supplier audits, with clear records for every order.

Logistics & distribution

Delivery planning, route and vehicle scheduling, depot coordination, and customer delivery updates, with transport compliance in mind.

Process & production improvement

Practical reviews of how work flows, where it stalls and what it costs, followed by simple standard procedures and performance measures.

SHEQ, food safety & compliance

Safety, health, environment and quality systems, work instructions and incident reporting, informed by ISO 22000 and HACCP training.

Operational readiness for enterprises

Setting up administration, costing, stock control and logistics in emerging enterprises, so they can supply consistently and keep funders’ investment working.

How we work with you

1

Diagnose

We walk the operation, review records and find where time, stock and money are lost.

2

Design

We agree practical systems, roles and controls that fit the size of your business.

3

Implement

We set the systems up, train your people and run the first cycles alongside you.

4

Monitor

We track performance against agreed measures and report plainly.

Our purpose

Turning responsible business into real participation

Stratovate exists to close the gap between good intentions and real outcomes in South Africa’s economy. Corporates, banks and institutions commit significant resources to transformation, enterprise development and community upliftment, yet too much of that spending does not translate into lasting change on the ground.

Our purpose is to make sure it does. We design and deliver programmes that build genuine capability in emerging enterprises, farmers and communities, and we measure and report honestly, so that responsible spending can be traced to a real result. When beneficiaries can operate, comply and supply, participation in the economy widens and growth becomes sustainable.

Their growth is our purpose. We turn responsible spending into participation that lasts.

4

Projects and experience

Experience of our directors

These projects were delivered by our directors in their own professional roles. They are not Stratovate engagements, and each one shapes how we work for clients today.

Youth and women entrepreneurship

Three-year youth entrepreneurship initiative

University of Pretoria, PwC and UNICEF. Capacity building and mentoring for about 500 rural youth and women entrepreneurs, with outcome reporting, partnership management and financial reporting. Delivered by Samantha Rabie through her role at the University of Pretoria.

Agri-entrepreneurship

Agri-Entrepreneurship Youth Development Programme

A short course designed and facilitated through the University of Pretoria, in partnership with SA Cane Growers. Delivered by Samantha Rabie through her role at the University of Pretoria.

Operations and logistics

Country-wide depot and supply chain operations

Leadership of depots, inventory, supply chain and warehousing with a team of 89, in multinational manufacturing and distribution. Led by Wesley Rabie in senior operations roles.

Scholarship and development

Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program

Second-round adjudicator for the programme, September 2026. Undertaken by Samantha Rabie in her personal professional capacity.

Community engagement

Mamelodi Business Hub collaboration

Community engagement promoting entrepreneurship and development-focused initiatives in Pretoria. Undertaken by Samantha Rabie through her role at the University of Pretoria.

Tender and bid administration

Tender support experience

Tender administration and submission support, drawn from Samantha Rabie's earlier career and now offered to clients as part of our compliance and bid readiness service.

Meet the team

Samantha Rabie

Founder & Managing Director
samantha.rabie@stratovate.co.za
Call 071 127 8158 · WhatsApp 074 301 3644

Samantha founded Stratovate Solutions and leads the firm across strategy, corporate social responsibility, corporate social investment and enterprise development. She designs and directs client programmes from first concept through to delivery and reporting, covering CSR and CSI strategy, socio-economic and supplier development, stakeholder engagement, research support, and monitoring and evaluation. She sets the company’s direction, owns its client relationships, and makes sure every engagement is practical, measurable and credible.

  • Over 20 years across higher education, development and the private sector
  • PhD candidate in Business Management and MPhil in Communication Management, University of Pretoria; PRISA member
  • Co-led a three-year University of Pretoria youth entrepreneurship initiative with PwC and UNICEF, building capacity and mentoring around 500 rural youth and women entrepreneurs
  • Designs and facilitates short courses, including the Agri-Entrepreneurship Youth Development Programme
  • Adjudicator for the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
  • Earlier career in tender administration, coordinating compliant bids across legal, technical and B-BBEE requirements
